summary: VModel's API pricing docs state new users receive a $10 free credit upon registration, with no credit card required. The credit is valid for all models, including image, video and text.
claim_steps: The $10 free credit is granted on signup; no credit card required

social_proof.title: Pricing & Billing Overview | Vmodel API Docs
social_proof.text: $10 free credit for new users upon signup. No credit card required. Valid for all models (image, video, text, etc.).
